data.body: PAUSE DISPOSITION after the completed >1s audit. In the three selected hosted runs the exact N=3000 node was 18.02s, 20.79s, and 20.61s on macOS; the current-main local census was 21.96s. It never exceeded 30s. Profiling continues to attribute 13.69s to the 24 real add/commit pairs required by curricular-mean-cuckoo's 3000-ticket/3000-comment/6000-event, exactly-24-commit, rollback, resume, and complete-state contract. The RAM-disk lever was 5.5-20% slower and reverted. No fidelity-preserving remediation exists; keep the test unchanged and move this ticket to blocked pending a matched hosted outlier profile or a lever that retains all 24 boundaries.
